summary: Usage-meter drawer rows share a native 22px table grid with aligned cells and sticky headers. Account/provider identity stays on one truncated, titled line; window labels, meters and percentages stay inline. Numeric columns use tabular figures and 2px vertical padding. The secondary comparison remains visible at normal sidebar widths and folds into the omitted-window disclosure only below 15rem. Dark/light eleven-row stories use fictional accounts.

schema.detail: No persisted or wire schema change.

compatibility.detail: Display facts, source adapters, sorting and detail/history contracts are unchanged. Aliases and full provider identity remain in the caption title; complete window evidence stays in row detail. Only the drawer table becomes denser.
